Relaunch a milestone with Workflow({scriptPath: <this folder>/dw-milestone.workflow.js, args: <milestones.json[M] with items filtered to the ids resume-state.sh still lists>}). 'base' is the commit the milestone's review diffs from (the previous checkpoint commit). M0 and M1 are complete; their args are kept short for the record.

M2.extra: M1 landed the pure kernels: NS.Constants, NS.ClassData, NS.Evaluate (Evaluate(facts,candidate,opts); prefs key '<classID>:<subClassID>'; facts.track.tier numeric from trackStringID else C.TRACK_TIER by enUS name; scorer(facts,candidate) may return 'pending'), NS.QualityGate, NS.Situations (classifier + edge), NS.TradeRules, NS.Messaging (pure state machine). Read their headers before using them; do not change their contracts without updating their tests and docs. M2 builds the EDGE modules that call WoW APIs: every version-variant/deprecated API goes through core/Compat.lua (created in DW-20, optionally routing secret checks through LibKa0s-Compat-1.0 via a setup/seam consistent with the scaffold's setup-file pattern). Every possibly-secret payload is guarded (IsSecret/CanAccess) before compare/concat/format. Events through the scaffold's feature-event registration so disable tears them down (test_disabled must stay green). Declare Perf buckets (spec §13) only together with a real bracket. Add docs/midnight-quirks.md and docs/compat-layer.md when their Tier 2 triggers fire. The mock: extend tests/wow_mock.lua (C_TooltipInfo, C_Item, NotifyInspect/INSPECT_READY, C_ChallengeMode, C_RestrictedActions, C_ChatInfo, GetInstanceInfo, timers) with controllable fakes.

M7.extra: M7 is the simulator (owner request 2026-10-11). Read docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-11-drop-watcher-simulator-design.md (the governing spec for M7) and docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-11-drop-watcher-simulator.md first, then docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. THE PRINCIPLE: the simulator invents client answers and events at the edges (through NS.Sim consulted by core/Compat.lua, and by calling the same handlers event registration calls, with real payload shapes); it never sets a verdict, trade state or inspect state itself — the real engine computes everything. Test mode (modules/TestMode.lua placeholders) stays as is; sim and test mode are exclusive. Safety rules of sim spec §5 are MUSTs: nothing is ever sent (enforced in the send seam), DB.global.history is never written by a sim, no real inspect or trade, stop cleans everything, refuse in a real group/instance/combat. compat-§1 holds: only core/Compat.lua calls the client, including the new Encounter Journal shims. Keep every authored file under 1000 lines (new files, not growth of Window.lua/Compat.lua/LootFeed.lua).

Plain stable client calls may live in the split files only if they are not version-variant; if any version-variant call sits outside core/Compat.lua, move pure code out of core/Compat.lua to make room and put it back there. Make sure ARCHITECTURE.md's Documented deviations records the split honestly, and draft (do not file) a WowAddonStandards proposal in issues-to-file.md to allow a core/Compat*.lua family if the split must stay.
